title: “Peace starts where our expectations end.”
paragraphs: When faith feels heavy, it’s probably our expectations doing the lifting

Micah 6:8 (NIV)
“He has shown you, O mortal, what is good.
And what does the Lord require of you?
To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.”
This verse distills faith into its simplest form — justice, mercy, humility — cutting through the noise of human complication.
